data.turoyo: Omər hano, u kurək, xəd zlam, malhamle hawxa.
data.translation: Es war, als ob ein Mann dem Jungen das eingegeben hätte.

rationale: Thin Preterit: hypothetical human inspirer contrasts with the established divine inspirer, without a change of lexical meaning.

summary: Both records are III Preterit and fit (ein)geben. The existing 4/10 form explicitly contains recipient -li, while 57/177 leaves the recipient to context.

In 57/177, how is the boy construed syntactically in the fragmented comparison? The supplied excerpt permits an understood recipient but does not settle every clause boundary.
